mktPrivacy.title: Privacy Policy
mktPrivacy.intro: This Privacy Policy (the "Policy") describes how Whasalia ("we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, maintains, and discloses information from users of our Platform. By accessing or using the Whasalia SaaS platform, you consent to the practices described in this Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the Platform.

s1.title: 1. User Data Collection
s1.body: We collect personal details that you provide directly to us during registration, setup, and support inquiries. This may include:
s1.i1: Your name, company name, billing address, and account details.
s1.i2: Email address (e.g., support details, correspondence logs).
s1.i3: WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) numbers and integration tokens.

s2.title: 2. CRM Data Storage
s2.body: All contact details, tags, logs, custom fields, and conversation histories uploaded or generated within the CRM dashboard are stored securely on our database. We employ advanced hosting architecture to ensure data isolation, high availability, and routine encrypted backups. Your customer records remain your property, and we act strictly as data processors for this information.

s3.title: 3. WhatsApp Communication
s3.body: To facilitate communications through the WhatsApp Business API, we transmit messaging payloads (text templates, quick-reply responses, dynamic variables, and rich media assets) directly to Meta's servers. These communications comply fully with the WhatsApp Business Platform policies. We do not inspect message contents except as technically required to render the service, trigger workflows, or debug API performance.

s4.title: 4. Cookies & Tracking Technologies
s4.body: We utilize persistent and session cookies to recognize authenticated user sessions, store dashboard configuration preferences, and monitor platform stability. You may opt to disable cookies in your browser settings, though doing so might affect platform performance and prevent access to certain interactive services.

s5.title: 5. Analytics & Usage Metrics
s5.body: To maintain high-quality uptime and diagnose performance anomalies, we track system parameters, browser types, log events, and screen interactions. These analytics help us optimize loading times, evaluate user flow effectiveness, and security-audit suspicious logins.

s6.title: 6. Security Practices
s6.body: Security is central to the Whasalia architecture. All data transfers between the browser and our servers are encrypted using TLS 1.3 (HTTPS). Core databases are isolated, and payment transactions are offloaded entirely to PCI-DSS compliant third-party payment gateways (e.g., Razorpay).

s7.title: 7. User Rights & Data Portability
s7.body: Under applicable data protection regulations (including Peru's Personal Data Protection Law No. 29733 and its regulations), you retain the right to request access to, correction or deletion of, or to object to the processing of the personal information stored in your account, as well as its export. To exercise these rights, write to the email address at the end of this policy.

s8.title: 8. Data Deletion Requests
s8.before: You may request complete and permanent deletion of your profile, CRM contact records, and metadata history at any time. Refer to our dynamic
s8.after: page or email our support desk. Upon validation, deletion is processed within 7 business days.

s9.title: 9. Third-Party Integrations
s9.body: Whasalia integrates with third-party software (such as e-commerce systems, spreadsheet tools, and messaging networks). We are not responsible for the privacy policies of these external platforms. We advise checking their independent terms before configuring webhook endpoints or sync permissions.

s10.title: 10. Contact & Regulatory Information
s10.body: For questions or requests regarding your data, contact Whasalia:

mktRefund.title: Subscription & Refund Policy
mktRefund.intro: At Whasalia, we deliver professional WhatsApp CRM and communication automation services. This policy clarifies terms regarding recurring subscriptions, setup configurations, custom developments, consulting sessions, and billing queries.

s1.title: 1. SaaS Subscriptions
s1.body: Our software platform is provided on a subscription basis (monthly or annually).
s1.i1: Subscribing plans carry a flat rate pass-through for Meta Business Platform usage fees without markups.
s1.i2: All subscription payments are non-refundable once the billing cycle begins.
s1.i3: You can cancel your subscription at any time to avoid future renewals; your dashboard access will remain active until the end of your prepaid period.

s2.title: 2. Account Onboarding & Setup Fees
s2.body: Setup and integration fees cover the direct labor involved in configuring your Meta Business Manager, applying for WhatsApp Business Account status, and mapping numbers.
s2.i1: These onboarding fees are non-refundable once configuration or account consultation has commenced.

s3.title: 3. Custom Development Workflows
s3.body: Fees collected for custom chatbot integrations, dedicated API plugins, webhook configurations, and customized flow building are governed by project-specific service level agreements (SLAs).
s3.i1: Since custom engineering involves dedicated development resources, these items are non-refundable once development milestones begin.

s4.title: 4. Consultation Services
s4.body: Fees for professional consultation sessions, strategy planning calls, and Meta compliance audits are earned upon booking. If you need to reschedule a consulting slot, you must contact your representative at least 24 hours in advance. No-shows or cancellations inside 24 hours are non-refundable.

s5.title: 5. Billing Disputes & Resolution
s5.body: If you identify a duplicate charge or billing error on your statement, you agree to raise an inquiry with our support department within 14 days of the invoice date.
s5.i1: We investigate all queries in good faith and correct verified platform glitches or billing errors immediately.
s5.i2: Initiating unauthorized chargebacks without contacting our billing desk will result in immediate workspace lockouts and possible collection procedures.

s6.title: 6. Contact Support
s6.body: For any queries regarding billing, invoice breakdowns, or cancellations, please contact our support desk:

mktDataDeletion.title: User Data Deletion Instructions
mktDataDeletion.subtitle: Whasalia Platform Guidelines
mktDataDeletion.intro: If you want to delete your personal data from the Whasalia platform, you can request data deletion using the steps below.
mktDataDeletion.step1: Log in to your account on the Whasalia platform.
mktDataDeletion.step3: Click on Delete Account or request account deletion.
mktDataDeletion.step4: You can also contact our support team to request deletion of your data.
mktDataDeletion.footer: Once we receive your request, your data will be permanently deleted from our system within 7 working days.
